title: Roadmap: move c64-re-tools onto stock VICE
summary: Proposes dropping the custom -mcpserver VICE build and driving unmodified x64sc through its binary monitor, with tool mapping, gaps, and a phased plan.
notes: Hybrid document. ADR signals: explicit 'Status: proposed' marker, Context ('The core finding') / Decision ('What changes (architecture)') / Consequences ('What it buys you', including costs and trade-offs), converging on one chosen architectural path. Competing SPEC signals: binary-monitor command opcodes, TCP framing details (STX 0x02, length, cmd, request-id, little-endian), and per-tool capability mapping. Competing DOC signals: filename 'roadmap', phased delivery plan, and verification steps read as planning prose rather than a contract. Resolved to ADR per the highest-precedence ambiguity rule; locked is false because status is 'proposed', not 'Accepted'. Downstream synthesizer should treat the phase list as plan-of-record, not as locked requirements.
